name: Breksta's Cat
author: NotImplementedLife; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Breksta's Cat by NotImplementedLife, a Game Boy Competition 2021 entry: walk around three small maps, talk to the locals and solve the sliding puzzles on the way to finding Breksta's cat. GPL-3.0 (github.com/NotImplementedLife/brekstascat).

descriptions.en: Breksta's Cat by NotImplementedLife, a Game Boy Competition 2021 entry: walk around three small maps, talk to the locals and solve the sliding puzzles on the way to finding Breksta's cat. GPL-3.0 (github.com/NotImplementedLife/brekstascat).
descriptions.it: Breksta's Cat di NotImplementedLife, in gara alla Game Boy Competition 2021: esplora tre piccole mappe, parla con gli abitanti e risolvi i puzzle a scorrimento che trovi lungo la strada per ritrovare il gatto di Breksta. GPL-3.0 (github.com/NotImplementedLife/brekstascat).
